topics.title: 现在完成时
topics.summary: 现在完成时表示过去的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，结构为 have/has + 过去分词。
rules: 结构：have/has + V-ed (过去分词)
He/She/It 用 has，其他主语用 have
时间标志：already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for
since + 时间点；for + 时间段

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has lived here for ten years.
Have you ever been to Beijing?

quiz.question: I ___ already eaten.
quiz.explanation: I 用 have。

quiz.question: She ___ been to Paris twice.
quiz.explanation: She 用 has。

quiz.question: We ___ known each other ___ 2010.
quiz.explanation: we 用 have；2010 是时间点用 since。

quiz.question: He has lived here ___ five years.
quiz.explanation: five years 是时间段用 for。

quiz.question: Have you ___ finished the book?
quiz.explanation: 肯定句中 already 表示已经；yet 用于否定和疑问句。

topics.title: 被动语态
topics.summary: 被动语态强调动作的承受者，结构为 be + 过去分词，时态由 be 动词体现。
rules: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + V-ed
一般过去时被动：was/were + V-ed
情态动词被动：情态动词 + be + V-ed
动作执行者用 by + 名词/宾格代词引出

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 英语在许多国家被使用。

examples.en: The window was broken by Tom.
Books should be read every day.

quiz.question: The book ___ by many students.
quiz.explanation: 书是「被读」的，用被动 is read。

quiz.question: The room ___ cleaned yesterday.
quiz.explanation: yesterday 过去时，单数主语用 was。

quiz.question: Apples ___ in autumn.
quiz.explanation: 苹果是被采摘的，复数用 are picked。

quiz.question: The work must ___ done today.
quiz.explanation: 情态动词 must + be + 过去分词。

quiz.question: The cake was made ___ my mom.
quiz.explanation: 动作执行者用 by。

topics.title: 宾语从句
topics.summary: 宾语从句作动词或介词的宾语，连接词常用 that、if/whether 以及特殊疑问词。
rules: 陈述句作宾语从句用 that 引导，that 可省略
一般疑问句作宾语从句用 if 或 whether 引导，从句用陈述语序
特殊疑问句作宾语从句用原疑问词引导，从句用陈述语序
时态呼应：主句过去时，从句一般也用过去时（除非客观真理）

examples.en: I think (that) he is right.
She asked if I was happy.
Do you know where he lives?

quiz.question: He said ___ he liked English.
quiz.explanation: 陈述句用 that 引导。

quiz.question: Do you know ___ he comes from?
quiz.explanation: 问来自哪里用 where。

quiz.question: She asked me ___ I had finished.
quiz.explanation: 一般疑问句作宾从用 if/whether。

quiz.question: I don't know ___ to do.
quiz.explanation: what to do = 做什么。

quiz.question: He told me that he ___ tired then.
quiz.explanation: 主句过去时，从句也用过去时 was。

topics.title: 定语从句
topics.summary: 定语从句修饰名词或代词（先行词），引导词包括关系代词 who, which, that 等。
rules: who 指人作主语或宾语
which 指物或动物
that 指人或物，常可代替 who/which
whose 表示「...的」，可指人或物
where 指地点，when 指时间

examples.en: The boy who is reading is my brother.
examples.zh: 正在读书的那个男孩是我弟弟。

examples.en: I like the book that you gave me.
examples.zh: 我喜欢你给我的那本书。

examples.en: This is the school where I studied.

quiz.question: The man ___ is talking is my dad.
quiz.explanation: 先行词是 the man (人)，作主语用 who。

quiz.question: The book ___ is on the desk is mine.
quiz.explanation: 先行词是 the book (物)，用 which。

quiz.question: This is the place ___ I was born.
quiz.explanation: 先行词是地点 the place，用 where。

quiz.question: I'll never forget the day ___ we met.
quiz.explanation: 先行词是时间 the day，用 when。

quiz.question: The girl ___ bag is red is Lisa.
quiz.explanation: 表示「...的」用 whose。

topics.title: if 条件句
topics.summary: if 引导真实条件状语从句，遵循 「主将从现」 原则。
rules: 主将从现：主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时
If + 主语 + V现在式, 主语 + will + V原
可表示真实可能发生的情况

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你努力学习，你会通过考试。

quiz.question: If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay home.
quiz.explanation: 从句一般现在时，主语 it 用 rains。

quiz.question: If you don't hurry, you ___ late.
quiz.explanation: 主句一般将来时 will be。

quiz.question: I will help you if I ___ free.
quiz.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时 am。

quiz.question: If she ___ hard, she will succeed.
quiz.explanation: 从句 she 第三人称单数现在时 works。

quiz.question: What will you do if it ___ rainy?
quiz.explanation: if 从句用现在时 is。

topics.title: 一般将来时
topics.summary: 一般将来时表示将来要发生的动作或状态，常用结构 will + V原 或 be going to + V原。
rules: will + 动词原形 (适用于所有人称)
be going to + 动词原形 (强调计划、打算或迹象)
时间标志：tomorrow, next week, in the future, soon

examples.en: I will visit my grandma next Sunday.
examples.zh: 下周日我要去看望奶奶。

examples.en: It is going to rain.
She will be a teacher.

quiz.question: I ___ play football tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: tomorrow 表将来用 will。

quiz.question: Look at the dark clouds. It ___ rain.
quiz.explanation: 看到迹象用 be going to。

quiz.question: She is going to ___ a doctor.
quiz.explanation: be going to + 动词原形。

quiz.question: We ___ have a party next week.
quiz.explanation: next week 将来时用 will。

quiz.question: Will you ___ to the cinema?
quiz.explanation: will 后接动词原形。

topics.title: 动词不定式
topics.summary: 动词不定式 to + V原，可作主语、宾语、定语、状语等。
rules: to + 动词原形
want/like/decide/plan/hope 后接 to do
make/let/help/see/hear sb. do (省略 to)
It is + adj + (for sb) + to do sth (常见句型)

examples.en: I want to learn English well.
It is important to be honest.
Let me help you.

quiz.question: I want ___ a doctor.
quiz.explanation: want 后接 to do。

quiz.question: It's nice ___ you.
quiz.explanation: It is + adj + to do 句型。

quiz.question: Let me ___ you with that.
quiz.explanation: let sb. do 省略 to。

quiz.question: I decided ___ harder.
quiz.explanation: decide 后接 to do。

quiz.question: He told me ___ here.
quiz.explanation: tell sb. to do sth.。

topics.title: 比较级与最高级
topics.summary: 形容词和副词的比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者及以上的比较。
rules: 比较级 + than
the + 最高级 + (in/of 范围)
最高级前一般加 the，但物主代词后不加 the
不规则：good/well → better → best；bad/badly → worse → worst

examples.en: Tom is taller than Jim.
She is the tallest girl in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我们班最高的女孩。

examples.en: This is my best friend.

quiz.question: He is the ___ student in his class.
quiz.explanation: in his class 范围三人以上，用最高级。

quiz.question: Math is ___ than English for me.
quiz.explanation: than 前用比较级 easier。

quiz.question: This is the ___ book I have ever read.
quiz.explanation: good 的最高级是 best。

quiz.question: Tom is ___ of the three boys.
quiz.explanation: 三者比较用最高级。

quiz.question: She runs ___ than me.
quiz.explanation: 比较级 faster。

topics.title: 感叹句
topics.summary: 感叹句以 What 或 How 开头，表达强烈情感。
rules: What + a/an + adj + 单数可数名词 + 主语 + 谓语!
What + adj + 复数/不可数名词 + 主语 + 谓语!
How + adj/adv + 主语 + 谓语!
How + adj + a/an + 单数可数名词 + 主语 + 谓语!

examples.en: What a nice day it is!
How beautiful she is!
What clever children they are!

quiz.question: ___ a nice day!
quiz.explanation: What + a + adj + 名词。

quiz.question: ___ beautiful the flowers are!
quiz.explanation: How + adj。

quiz.question: ___ delicious food it is!
quiz.explanation: food 是不可数，用 What + adj + 不可数名词。

quiz.question: ___ fast he runs!
quiz.explanation: How + adv (fast 是副词)。

quiz.question: ___ interesting books they are!
quiz.explanation: books 是复数名词，用 What。

topics.title: 状语从句
topics.summary: 状语从句修饰主句的谓语，常见有时间、原因、条件、让步等类型。
rules: 时间状语：when, while, as, before, after, since, until
原因状语：because, since, as
条件状语：if, unless
让步状语：although, though, even though

examples.en: I was reading when she came in.
He was late because he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 他迟到了因为没赶上公交车。

examples.en: Although it rained, we went out.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是出去了。

quiz.question: I'll wait ___ you come back.
quiz.explanation: until 表示 「直到」。

quiz.question: He stayed at home ___ he was ill.
quiz.explanation: 原因状语用 because。

quiz.question: ___ it was cold, he went swimming.
quiz.explanation: 让步关系用 Although。

quiz.question: I won't go ___ you go with me.
quiz.explanation: unless = if not，意为「除非」。

quiz.question: Don't talk ___ the teacher is speaking.
quiz.explanation: while 强调一段时间内同时进行。
